# CredentialCloudKind

The cloud an Anthropic credential reaches Claude through, in place of Anthropic's own API.

**Kind:** a string enum, used in requests and responses.

## Values

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `"Bedrock"` | Amazon Bedrock: the key is a Bedrock API key (bearer token). |
| `"Vertex"` | Google Vertex AI: the key is a service account's JSON key file, pasted whole. |

New values can appear, so treat one you don't know as "something else", not as an error.

## Where it's used

- Inside [`CredentialCloud`](credential-cloud.md)
